us-china.status: U.S. export controls on AI chips and bans on Chinese AI models remain in force, and agencies have been ordered to strip DeepSeek technology from their systems. DeepSeek has just secured roughly $15 billion in new funding and is preparing for a potential STAR Market IPO, possibly as early as next year.

frontier-race.status: Frontier AI labs continue rolling out major models and integrations: OpenAI’s GPT‑6 series is now on Google Cloud, NVIDIA’s open‑weight Nemotron 3.5 family targets European enterprises, and Mistral’s Large 4 preview is underway. New research highlights faster flow‑based language models, large agentic MoE systems, AI‑designed therapeutic proteins, and planet‑scale satellite embeddings. Industry adoption expands across cloud marketplaces, automotive infotainment, and large corporate deployments like Volkswagen’s Copilot rollout.
frontier-race.changed: The latest stories add a fast flow language model, a large agentic MoE model, AI‑generated protein binders, and a global satellite embedding model.

timeline.text: AllenAI released OlmoEarth v1.3 satellite embedding model with global 128‑dim vectors.
OpenAI, PerturbAI, Scripps deploy AI agents to analyze millions of brain cells, identifying research leads.
NVIDIA releases open-weight Nemotron 3.5 and Kumo models for European industry customization.
OpenAI’s frontier models and Codex workflows become available on Google Cloud Marketplace.
Microsoft equips 330,000 Volkswagen employees with Copilot suite, boosting productivity.
Google adds conversational Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay in the US.
GPT‑6 Astra tops LIBERO‑10 robot tasks with 44% success, Gemini‑4 Argon close second.
Mistral previews 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4, planning weight release by end‑Oct 2026.
Mistral launches Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models for real‑time agents.
Environment Duels benchmark reveals author‑solver dynamics across nine frontier models.
Microsoft researchers prove KLS conjecture using human‑directed AI, advancing high‑dimensional geometry.
OpenAI rolls out GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models on Google Cloud with private‑preview for enterprises.
Anthropic releases Claude Duet AI agent research preview on Opus 5.5 for US Pro/Max users.
Mistral and Mozilla launch Firefox Smart Window beta browsing assistant in France and North America.
Lafa flow language model released, 8 B parameters, 2.5× faster inference.
Sage‑A1.5 35 B‑parameter MoE agentic model launched for long‑horizon tasks.
Claude generated 211 protein minibinder designs; 17 validated binders against scorpion neurotoxins.

ai-regulation.status: The United States is expected to maintain a light‑touch regulatory approach, with no major AI legislation forthcoming. The UBS report projects AI will boost growth and capex in 2026, allowing developers to operate under voluntary safety agreements. Other jurisdictions’ AI rules remain unchanged in this update.
ai-regulation.changed: US unlikely to adopt major AI regulations as UBS predicts light‑touch approach.

india-ai.status: India has introduced a domestic framework to assess the trustworthiness of AI used in defence, emphasizing reliability, safety and transparency. At the same time, Vultr has commissioned a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai equipped with AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, providing substantial on‑premise compute for Indian AI labs and enterprises. These developments signal both policy and infrastructure progress in India’s AI push.
india-ai.changed: The newest stories add a defence AI trustworthiness framework and a large AI supercluster in Chennai.

timeline.text: India creates domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence

agent-safety.status: Meta has temporarily disabled the Muse feature that let users share AI conversations via web links, after researchers found over 6,800 publicly accessible links exposing personal and business data.
agent-safety.changed: Meta paused the Muse conversation‑sharing feature after a security firm uncovered thousands of publicly accessible links exposing data.

copyright.status: AI training on copyrighted song lyrics is currently being litigated. Anthropic has presented a fair‑use defense for its Claude model, while major music publishers argue the practice harms songwriters. The upcoming court decision will set a precedent for future AI training practices.
